_comment: MCP connectors Aura can reach. Same shape as ~/.claude.json and Claude
Desktop's config, which are also read — adding a server to either of
those makes it reachable here with no duplicate entry needed.
This file ships EMPTY on purpose. A plausible-looking default list would
make Aura describe a reach she does not have.
Each entry:
command   required, the program to launch
args      optional list of strings
env       optional; KEY names whose values are read from the owner's
environment at launch. Values are never stored here and
never enter Aura's context. A declared key that is unset
fails the call with that reason instead of an auth error.
purpose   optional one-line description, used when Aura is asked what
she can reach
Example (not active):
"sentry": {
"command": "npx",
"args": ["-y", "@sentry/mcp-server"],
"env": {"SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN": ""},
"purpose": "read issues and events from Sentry"
